reviews.reason: Affected XML parsing library; NOT claimed fixed or not affected. Debian explicitly classifies the trixie issue as no-dsa / Minor issue and has no fixed stable package. Temporarily defer this exact vendor-minor denial-of-service finding while shipping the independently verified critical PHP RCE fixes. No site-specific exploitability assumption is made. A newly available fix, changed package version, changed distribution or expiry blocks release again.

The advisory concerns executable Linux kernel fs/nfsd implementation. linux-libc-dev supplies userspace development headers, not a running kernel/NFS server. This review applies only to this header package in the WordPress image, never to a host kernel, linux-image package, NFS server or any other package. Host kernel patch status remains outside this image review.
